scripts.build:wasm:skip: sh -c 'if [ -f pkg/collision.js ]; then echo "Skipping WASM build - using pre-built WASM files from pkg/"; else echo "ERROR: Pre-built WASM files not found in pkg/ and cannot build (cargo missing)"; exit 1; fi'
scripts.build: sh -c '[ -f ../../.wasm-pack-env.sh ] && . ../../.wasm-pack-env.sh || true; command -v wasm-pack >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1 && (pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm run build:ts) || (pnpm run build:wasm:skip && pnpm run build:ts)'
